input.brief:
Design a beautiful, single-storey luxury Caribbean villa on completely flat land, with three spacious bedrooms, two bathrooms, a large open-plan living and dining area, and a modern kitchen.

Use elegant Mediterranean-Caribbean architecture with warm terracotta pitched roofs, cream stucco walls, natural stone accents, large windows, and a welcoming covered entrance.

Include a generous covered veranda overlooking a rectangular swimming pool, connected outdoor terraces, tropical landscaping, and a driveway.

slice.name: Terracotta Courtyard Villa
slice.concept: A single-storey Mediterranean-Caribbean villa composed as a calm, low-slung sequence of cream stucco pavilions under warm terracotta pitched roofs. Three private bedroom suites form a quieter wing, while a broad central living, dining, and kitchen pavilion opens fully toward a covered veranda, terraces, and a rectangular pool. Natural stone anchors the entry and garden-facing plinths; large shaded openings make the indoor and outdoor rooms read as one.
hierarchy: Arrival mass: a sheltered entry pavilion with a stone-clad threshold and clearly legible covered porch.
Living heart: the largest central pavilion containing open-plan living, dining, and modern kitchen, oriented directly to the pool and veranda.
Private wing: a quieter three-bedroom volume set back from the social pavilion, with two well-appointed bathrooms serving the sleeping accommodation.
Garden edge: a deep covered veranda continues into connected sun terraces around a rectangular swimming pool, creating the primary outdoor living room.
Service/arrival edge: a discreet driveway and landscaped forecourt maintain a composed approach without competing with the pool garden.
slice.roofLanguage: Warm terracotta clay tile pitched roofs, expressed as a family of low, elegant hipped forms with generous overhangs for shade and rain protection. The main living pavilion carries the most prominent roof, while bedroom and entry roofs step down in scale to establish a relaxed Caribbean silhouette. Roof color: #B65A36.
slice.entrance: A welcoming covered entrance is recessed beneath a pitched porch roof, approached from the driveway through a tropical forecourt. Cream stucco walls are framed by natural limestone accents at the threshold, with broad timber-toned doors and shaded glazing giving the arrival a refined, hospitable character.
slice.outdoorLiving: The living and dining room opens onto a generous covered veranda facing the rectangular swimming pool. The veranda accommodates lounging and outdoor dining, with connected terraces extending into sunny poolside areas. Deep eaves, ceiling-fan-ready soffits, and large openings provide a comfortable transition from the interior to the garden throughout the day.
slice.landscape: A formal yet lush tropical landscape combines palms, layered flowering shrubs, broad-leaf planting, and low groundcovers. A planted arrival drive leads to the covered entry, while denser perimeter greenery protects privacy. Around the pool, restrained planting frames clear terrace zones and preserves long views from the veranda across the water.
